convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicators (Hans_Indicator_Cloud_System) which require custom .ex5 files, plus multi-timeframe logic with iCustom calls on different timeframes

derived_values.name: Higher timeframe derived from current timeframe
derived_values.formula: PERIOD_H1 or next higher TF based on TimeFrame input

other_exits: Reverse position on opposite signal from Hans_Indicator_Cloud_System
Multi-timeframe confirmation: higher TF cloud system must agree with current TF signal

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative Lots value = fixed lot size (absolute value used). Positive Lots value = deposit fraction/risk percent sizing

custom_logic_notes: EA uses custom indicator Hans_Indicator_Cloud_System via iCustom() on both current timeframe and a higher timeframe for dual-timeframe confirmation. Opposite signal triggers close of existing position and potential reversal entry. The 'Tm_Plus' variant adds time management filtering for trade session control. Digit adjustment multiplies SL/TP/Trailing by 10 when _Digits is 5 or 3 (5-digit/3-digit brokers).
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of the Hans_Indicator_Cloud_System custom indicator logic in Python since iCustom() calls depend on a compiled .ex5 binary unavailable outside MT5. Must reverse-engineer or obtain the indicator source code. Multi-timeframe confirmation logic requires careful alignment of bar timestamps across timeframes. Digit adjustment logic for 5-digit brokers must be replicated. The conditional position sizing (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction) needs explicit branching in Python.
